composition_policy.high_value_legitimate_structure: Included. Provides sensitive, state-changing, destructive, access-control, financial, credential-related, or broad-scope actions under explicit legitimate authorization.
composition_policy.usable_legitimate_structure: Included. Provides normal read-only or lower-impact legitimate user goals.
composition_policy.ambiguous_structure: Retained in the audit ledger but excluded from contextual composition until prompt/reference-sequence mismatches are resolved.

important_note: Legitimate structure value and action impact do not determine the Phase-1 runtime general_risk_label. High-impact legitimate actions are intentionally retained as hard-negative composition material.
